reviews.title: Not great for Guinea pigs
reviews.body: I bought these in hopes of stopping the water leaking and making a mess. Unfortunately these just brought a new issue, they easily get poop and bedding stuck into the drinking part and it is difficulties clean. Not to mention you have to clean it several times a day because of how often things fall into it. Would not recommend for guineas or any other small animal that has wood chip bedding or paper bedding.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on October 10, 2022
reviews.author: Jacquelyn

reviews.title: Excellent choice for ferrets!
reviews.body: My ferrets have an easy time drinking from these without gleefully throwing the water everywhere like they tend to do with their water bowl. I am very satisfied because now I know they will never run out of water!
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on December 6, 2025
reviews.author: Laura

reviews.title: I personally like them
reviews.body: For me, they work well. They look like the picture. They are easy to install although they are harder to squeeze through smaller bars. Mine don’t leak. And the bottle comes out easily to be refilled. It holds a lot of water for my bunnies. They can drink from a dish instead of a bottle which is supposed to be better for them. The bars do need to be vertical and at least an inch or inch and a half apart for it to fit minimally. Make sure to read that part or you will be disappointed but it does fit larger bars.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on May 22, 2024
reviews.author: Stephanie

reviews.title: Ehh they are okay
reviews.body: **Update.  These lasted less than a year. They started leaking from the bottom of the water bottle. This was due to the seal wearing out. Ended up tossing them.**These work OK for the money. After using them for several months, my bunnies ended up breaking out the little plastic pieces in the bottom of the water dish. They’re just not very durable. The good news is the water seems to work just fine without that, but I bet I have to replace them within a year.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on July 9, 2025
reviews.author: Reviews 1234

reviews.title: Picky rabbit loves it
reviews.body: Got this for my rabbit who never drinks enough water and was beginning to have some health issues because of that. I'd already tried various bowls, a water fountain, the water bottle with the straw, adding apple juice to her water, etc...nothing worked. But this bottle she loves. Now I see her drinking a good amount of water every day. The bars on your hutch do have to be fairly tall or wide for this to fit and the bottom has to rest on something (a lower rung works) or it pops off. But this got my picky girl drinking her water so in my book it's gold. Great for pets who hate getting their whiskers wet.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on October 6, 2022
reviews.author: Randi

reviews.title: Love/hate relationship
reviews.body: I love that these water bottles attach to cage walls so that my guinea pigs can drink out of a bowl without the bowl being on the floor for them to fill it with crap, literally. However, I have a lot of things about them that I don't like. For starters, you can't attach it to a c&c cage because the bowl part of it is pretty long when you turn it on its side to attach it. You have to snap the botton tray piece to the base that holds the water bottle, otherwise it will probably leak or not stay attached right but its really difficult to do that. The problem with that is that once it's connected, it's a mother to try to take it apart. I ended up bruising my knuckle taking them apart to clean them. The whole thing is plastic so of course lots of slimy buildup occurs and daily/every other day cleaning is necessary. If they came with a brush that made it easier to clean, I probably wouldn't have as much of an issue with it. I imagine that I'll get sick of these after a couple months and throw them out or use them for a different animal like quail or bunnies because the guinea pigs just love to throw poop into the trays no matter how high I put them.Overall, they're okay. I don't want more than 2 of them, I don't even know that I want the 2 of them but I have them and I keep using them so I guess they're fine.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on January 1, 2025
reviews.author: Natalie

reviews.title: Do not like it’s plastic not glass
reviews.body: I did not like these. I didn’t know they were gonna be plastic instead of glass and one of the plastic containers had a hole and leaked water everywhere. Had to replace with a new one.

features: [Safe Material]: Rabbit water bottle is made of safe PP plastic, which is strong and durable, with a large capacity of 600ml, ensuring that your pet can keep enough water during your short absence for a few days, reducing mess. Package Contents 2 PCS bunny water bottle

[Automatic Water Outlet]: The water outlet of the guinea pig water bottle is a circular hollow design, which reduces the risk of illness caused by pets' wet mouths when they drink water. Siphon design to prevent water leakage and dust from entering

[No Noise]: Rabbit water bottle no drip compared to traditional ball bearing water bottle, your pet will not make an annoying noise when drinking water, providing your furry bunny with a more comfortable and hygienic drinking experience

[Hanging Design]: Hang the rabbit water dispenser at a height suitable for guinea pigs to prevent neck discomfort caused by pets drinking water with their heads up or down. Buttons are designed to fit most small pet cages and fit inside and outside of the cage as needed

[Easy to Use & Clean]: Connect the screw buttons that come with the water bottle for guinea pig between the cage wires, making it stable and not easy to tip over. Each part is detachable for easy cleaning with a small brush after prolonged use
